en.topic_title: Hong Kong police officer stabbed during 2020 protest seeks at least HK$220K in damages
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong police officer has sought at least HK$220,000 in damages from a man who stabbed him during a protest in 2020.



Police in Causeway Bay on July 1, 2020. File Photo: May James/HKFP.



Lui Chun-kit addressed the courtroom at the District Court on Monday, testifying that he sustained multiple muscle tears and required surgery.
